mappings.note: Both serve as the superscription/introductory title. Content matches: 'To the choirmaster', 'Psalm of David', 'A song'. OSMAIN v1 includes 'For you silence is praise...', which corresponds to Translation v2's opening, but structurally this verse acts as the header in both.

Translation v2 ('O Dieu, la louange t'attend dans Sion...') corresponds to the second half of OSMAIN v1 ('For you silence is praise, God, on Zion, and to you vows will be fulfilled'). The first part of Translation v2 matches the end of OSMAIN v1.
Translation: 'O toi qui entends la prière...' vs OSMAIN: 'Du som hører bønn...'. Content is identical.
Translation: 'Les iniquités avaient prévalu...' vs OSMAIN: 'Syndens byrde er for tung...'. Both convey the same meaning of sin being too heavy but forgiven.
Translation: 'Heureux celui que tu choisis...' vs OSMAIN: 'Salig er den du utvelger...'. Content matches perfectly.
Translation: 'Tu nous répondras par des œuvres redoutables...' vs OSMAIN: 'Med fryktinngytende gjerninger svarer du oss...'. Content matches.
Translation: 'Il tient ferme les montagnes...' vs OSMAIN: 'Du som grunnfester fjellene...'. Content matches.
Translation: 'Il apaise le bruit des mers...' vs OSMAIN: 'Du stiller havenes brusen...'. Content matches.
Translation: 'Et ceux qui habitent aux bouts de la terre...' vs OSMAIN: 'De som bor ved jordens ender...'. Content matches.
Translation: 'Tu visites la terre...' vs OSMAIN: 'Du ser til jorden...'. Content matches.
Translation: 'Tu abreuves ses sillons...' vs OSMAIN: 'Du vanner dens furer...'. Content matches.

Translation v12 contains the phrase 'et les roues de ton char distillent l'abondance' (and the wheels of your chariot drip abundance). OSMAIN v11 only says: 'Du kroner året med din godhet, og dine spor drypper av overflod' (You crown the year with your goodness, and your tracks drip with abundance). The specific imagery of 'wheels of a chariot' is an interpretive expansion in the translation not present in the OSMAIN text.
Translation: 'Elles la répandent sur les pâturages...' vs OSMAIN: 'Ørkenens beitemarker drypper...'. Content matches.
Translation: 'Les campagnes sont revêtues de troupeaux...' vs OSMAIN: 'Engene er kledd med sauer...'. Content matches.

extraContent.description: The phrase 'et les roues de ton char distillent l'abondance' (and the wheels of your chariot drip abundance) appears in Translation v12. The corresponding OSMAIN v11 only mentions 'dine spor drypper av overflod' (your tracks/footprints drip with abundance). The specific reference to 'chariot wheels' is an addition in the translation.
